Name: More Remixed Bundles
Author: Suntooth
Description:
Remixed bundles are incredibly underutilised in the base game. This mod adds some extra options that may or may not show up in your playthroughs. It should be compatible with any other mod that edits remixed bundles (although it won't use items from any other mods in the bundles, just vanilla items).

[b]Note: [/b]As of upload, this mod only contains [i]one[/i] extra bundle. I plan to update it in the future, but that may be a while away - I wanted to make and upload this mostly as a proof of concept for now. The bundles added by this mod will only apply to newly created saves, as far as I know.

Current list of bundles the mod adds:
[spoiler][b]Boiler Room[/b]
[list]
[*]Geode Collector's Bundle: 3 Geodes, 1 Frozen Geode, 1 Magma Geode, 1 Omni Geode[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
